name: Baron Bloodmore and the Crimson Castle

features.name: Massive mystery symbols
features.description: Large blocks that reveal a single symbol.

review:
Baron Bloodmore and the Crimson Castle is a 25-line vampire slot with multiplying cash wins, massive mystery symbols and two bonus games.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 25,000x cap and a 96.07% RTP. The gothic art is among the studio's best, and the giant mystery symbols can cover much of the grid.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
